title: A sorted address book
description:
Keep contacts in a generic vector, sort them several ways and search them.

```
> add Ada Lovelace ada@example.com
> add Alan Turing alan@example.com
> sort name
> find Turing
Alan Turing <alan@example.com>
> list
```
hints: `bsearch` must use the same comparison as the `qsort` before it (lesson 8.02).
Copy names with `snprintf(c.first, sizeof c.first, "%s", word)` so a long name is cut instead of overflowing.
requirements: A `void *`-based vector (lesson 8.02) of `struct contact { char first[32], last[32], email[64]; }`.
`qsort` with comparison functions by last name, first name and email; `bsearch` for `find` after sorting by last name.
Lines read with a growing buffer, so long input never overflows.
stretch: Save the book to a file and load it at start-up.
